race.comment: CZECH OUT (1) has been well placed to win his last couple of starts and has progressed quickly since scoring his maiden win near the end of September at Murray Bridge. He has to shoulder the full 62kg here, but the hat-trick beckons. VANDAROSS (2) won his maiden at Gawler at his penultimate start, before running on too late last time out behind the top pick in the same race. The extra 150m is the key here, and Jacob Opperman sticks. Each way value. TWEETER (4) showed talent as a juvenile and resumes for the in-form Sarah Rutten stable for the first time. She has trialled up nicely, and from the pole position, she will be ready to rumble. ANNIE'S CROFT (5) did not beat much on debut at Naracoorte, but did so in style, scoring by nearly 2 lengths. She drops in weight and will again be competitive. ARIZONA DREAMER (6) flew home from near last when scoring fresh up in midweek company 11 days ago. She has more to offer and has to be respected.
